                (ar."HIST_sign" + CAST(ar.rating_profile->>'research_score' AS numeric) + CAST(ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score' AS numeric)) 
                * (10 - CASE ac.conserve_status 
                    WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 
                    WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 
                    WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 
                    WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 
                    WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 
                    ELSE 5 END) 
                / 30.0 AS numeric), 2
        ) AS calculated_score
    FROM "ArtifactsCore" ac
    JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ar ON ac."ARTregID" = ar."ART_link"
    WHERE ac.conserve_status IS NOT NULL AND ac.conserve_status <> 'None'
)
SELECT 
    cc.title,
    cc.calculated_score AS cpi_score,
    s.hall_ref AS hall_id,
    ra.risk_level
FROM cpi_calc cc
JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON cc.artifact_id = ca.art_exam
JOIN "Showcases" s ON ca.case_exam = s."caseID"
JOIN "RiskAssessments" ra ON cc.artifact_id = ra.art_concern
WHERE cc.calculated_score > 7
ORDER BY cc.calculated_score DESC;
